entries.title: Reading the parameters of a sinusoid
entries.description: extract amplitude, angular frequency, and phase from $A\sin(\omega_0 t+\phi)$.

entries.title: Converting between period and angular frequency
entries.description: use the relationship between $T$ and $\omega_0$ for a sinusoid.

entries.title: Interpreting sinusoid phase
entries.description: understand phase as setting where the sinusoid starts and how it shifts in time.

entries.title: Identifying harmonics
entries.description: recognize first, second, third, and higher harmonics as integer multiples of a fundamental frequency.

entries.title: Computing harmonic angular frequencies
entries.description: use $\omega_k = k\omega_0$ to determine a harmonic's angular frequency.
